environment.description: AWS Lambda (Quarkus native) deployed in account 112233445566, us-east-1. Lambda execution role arn:aws:iam::112233445566:role/DiagnosticLambdaRole has AmazonS3FullAccess and AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole managed policies. No permission boundary attached. Lambda runs in default VPC with internet access. API Gateway endpoint is public with no authorization. The Lambda runtime includes /bin/sh, /usr/bin/ping, /usr/bin/curl, and standard Linux utilities in the AL2 container image.
